method: Built-in image generation; each artist used their main character portrait and character sheet from Spielbot Settings > Characters.

prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new premium music-artist promotional photographic portrait for a website artist card. Input image 1 is the authoritative face portrait; input image 2 is the character sheet for identity, anatomy and wardrobe consistency. Dayo Ember. Warm Nigerian soul singer, pale blue open shirt over white tee as references, inviting quiet confidence, warm amber side light with deep midnight-blue studio backdrop. Preserve exactly the character's face, apparent age, skin tone, hairstyle and recognizable identity from both references. Single person, editorial music photography, nuanced real skin detail, crisp eyes, tactile wardrobe, polished yet natural. Vertical 2:3 composition, head and upper torso to waist, head completely inside frame with generous headroom, face in upper third and centered so image also crops well to 4:5. Expressive subtle three-quarter body angle with eyes toward camera. A fresh intentional portrait, not a copy of the original pose. Beautiful controlled studio lighting with subtle atmospheric depth. No lettering, no logos, no borders, no contact sheet or multiple panels. High resolution.
